T V Narendran, Saurabh Agrawal, and Ashish Chauhan Identified as Tata Sons Succession Contenders

T V Narendran, Saurabh Agrawal, and Ashish Chauhan have emerged as the primary contenders for the succession at Tata Sons. Narendran and Agrawal are positioned as the leading candidates in the race. Ashish Chauhan, who is associated with the National Stock Exchange (NSE), is described as a potential dark horse candidate for the role.
